catalog.title: Products and categories
catalog.body: This is the catalog of every product and consumable on the warehouse. The category tree is on the left, the product list on the right: price, stock in both units, and "Low", "Expired" and "Expiring soon" badges. Tick several products to quickly change their price or stock, or archive them.

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.body: A warehouse splits products by purpose: one for consumables written off against services, another for products you sell. "Move products" transfers stock from one warehouse to another — for example, when a display shelf runs low.

operations.title: Stock movements
operations.body: The log shows every stock movement: income, sales, write-offs and transfers. Click the date or the visit to open the record, the product to open its card; "Show" next to history lists who changed the document and when.

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.body: A list of the business's equipment: purchase date, warranty, and a reminder for when it's time to service or replace it.

priceTags.title: Price tags
priceTags.body: Tick products on the left — a print-ready price tag preview with the name, price and barcode appears on the right.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: A warehouse summary: the value of stock on hand, how many products are below critical stock, how many are expiring or expired, and a breakdown by category.

techCards.title: Service recipes
techCards.body: A recipe sets how much consumable a service uses. Once it's linked to a service, the consumable will be written off the "Consumables" warehouse automatically at the client's visit — no manual write-off. Before you can create a recipe, the "Consumables" warehouse needs at least one income of that consumable, otherwise there is nothing to write off.

settings.title: Warehouse settings
settings.body: Cost price is calculated either from the last income price or as a weighted average across all incomes — the choice affects profit in reports. The warning period sets how many days before expiry a product gets the "Expiring soon" label.
